LanguageData.VGE_HostileWarcomputer.label: hostile warcomputer
LanguageData.VGE_HostileWarcomputer.description: The tactical core of an orbital warplatform. This advanced supercomputer maintains active target locks and manages the platform's long-range artillery systems. It can be accessed and hacked to download a payload of gravdata, scaling based on progress on the currently selected gravtech research project. Destroying or hacking the warcomputer will disable the platform entirely.
LanguageData.VGE_HostileWarcomputer.comps.3.label: Warcomputer
LanguageData.VGE_HostileWarcomputer.comps.3.text: You've discovered a hostile warcomputer running an orbital warplatform. Destroy it to disable all platform weaponry and obtain a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.label: enemy gravjumper engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.description: A compact gravtech engine designed for short-range jumps within a planet's atmosphere. The gravjumper engine creates a brief, localized distortion in gravitational flow, allowing rapid vertical lift, but does not produce forward thrust. It can't function far from a large gravity well like a planet, so it is useless for interplanetary travel.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.comps.3.label: Gravjumper engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumperEngine.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy gravjumper engine. Destroy it to obtain a gravcore and permanently disable the vessel's ability to move.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.label: enemy gravship engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.description: The ultratech heart of a gravship. The grav engine generates lift by inverting and intensifying the effect of gravity in a field around itself. This engine can lift upwards, but does not produce forward thrust.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.comps.3.label: Gravship engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravEngine.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy gravship engine. Destroy it to obtain a gravcore and permanently disable the ship's ability to move.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.label: enemy gravhulk engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.description: The gravhulk is a colossal class of gravship, engineered to transport entire megacolonies, orbital platforms, or mobile city-cores across the skies of a planet. The grav engine generates lift by inverting and intensifying the effect of gravity in a field around itself. This engine can lift upwards, but does not produce forward thrust. It can't function far from a large gravity well like a planet, so it is useless for interplanetary travel.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.comps.3.label: Gravhulk engine
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravhulkEngine.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy gravhulk engine. Destroy it to obtain a gravcore and permanently cripple this massive vessel's mobility.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravlockTether.label: enemy gravlock tether
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravlockTether.description: The gravlock tether is the core stabilization unit of an orbital station, anchoring it in a fixed position. A specialized conversion of the gravhulk engine, this device generates a stabilized gravitational field to maintain the station's orbital trajectory.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravlockTether.comps.3.label: Gravlock tether
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravlockTether.comps.3.text: You've discovered an enemy gravlock tether, anchoring an orbital base in place. Destroy it to obtain a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotCockpit.label: enemy pilot cockpit
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotCockpit.description: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravjumper. It draws power directly from the grav engine.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotConsole.label: enemy pilot console
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotConsole.description: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravship. It draws power directly from the grav engine.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotBridge.label: enemy pilot bridge
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPilotBridge.description: An interface that allows launching and piloting a gravhulk. It draws power directly from the grav engine.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyTargetingTerminal.label: enemy targeting terminal
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyTargetingTerminal.description: An enemy control terminal responsible for calibrating the nearby gravship artillery turrets.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyTargetingConsole.label: enemy targeting console
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyTargetingConsole.description: A large, enemy targeting console responsible for calibrating the reload sequence of nearby gravship artillery pieces.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAlgaeOxygenator.label: enemy algae oxygenator
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAlgaeOxygenator.description: A vital device that processes harvested oxyalgae into breathable oxygen. Converts biomass into gas and pumps it into the oxygen network to supply pressurized rooms and equipment.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAstrofuelSynthesizer.label: enemy astrofuel synthesizer
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAstrofuelSynthesizer.descriptio: A specialized structure that refines chemfuel into high-grade astrofuel.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussBombard.label: enemy gauss bombard
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussBombard.description: A heavy, slow-firing electromagnetic launcher that discharges bursts of two kinetic impactors. Designed to bombard locations designated by an orbital bombardment targeter.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGaussBombard.label: enemy gauss bombard
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_GaussBombard.label: gauss bombard shot
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussGun.label: enemy gauss gun
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussGun.description: A small, single-barrel electromagnetic cannon that launches dense uranium slugs at extreme velocities. Designed for both local bombardments and medium-range engagements, it can also target other gravships in orbit. It draws power directly from the grav engine and does not require a linked terminal to function.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGaussGun.label: enemy gauss gun
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyJavelinPod.label: enemy javelin pod
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyJavelinPod.description: A compact multi-tube missile platform that launches a volley of six guided astrofuel javelins. Meant for fast, hard-hitting strikes against exposed gravships and unarmored surface forces. It draws power directly from the grav engine and does not require a linked terminal to function.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyJavelinPod.label: enemy javelin pod
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftCaster.label: enemy anticraft caster
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftCaster.description: A medium gravship-mounted energy weapon that fires short, razor-sharp bursts of cutting beam with surgical precision. Built to punch holes through critical systems, the caster trades sustained suppression for rapid, accurate strikes. It draws power directly from the grav engine and does not require a linked terminal to function.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyAnticraftCaster.label: enemy anticraft caster
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeam.label: enemy anticraft beam
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeam.description: A massive anti-ship beam weapon intended to destroy flying craft, but also capable of firing onto the surface from space. Ships using ultratech signal jammers can delay the targeting of these weapons.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be destroyed to yield some valuable resources, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeam.comps.4.label: Beam emitter
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeam.comps.4.text: You've discovered an anticraft beam. This powerful orbital weapon can annihilate any gravship that challenges it. Destroy it to secure the airspace and obtain a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyAnticraftBeam.label: enemy anticraft beam
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_AnticraftBeam.label: anticraft beam
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyAnticraftBeamStrike.label: anticraft beam strike
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPointDefenseTurret.label: enemy point defense turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyPointDefenseTurret.description: A specialized defensive turret built exclusively for gravships. It intercepts explosive projectiles and incoming drop pods within its protective radius, but cannot engage ground targets. Interception chance scales with the target’s velocity.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyPointDefense.label: point defense gun
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyPointDefense.description: A rapid-fire gun for point-defense applications.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyShieldGenerator.label: enemy shield generator
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyShieldGenerator.description: A shielding device that can protect a gravship. It modulates the grav field to create a short-lived momentum repulsor surface that blocks projectiles. It works against normal shots and mortars. Those inside can still shoot out. It must be charged before use.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyLargeShieldGenerator.label: large enemy shield generator
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyLargeShieldGenerator.descriptio: A large-scale shielding device that can protect a gravship. It modulates the grav field to create a short-lived momentum repulsor surface that blocks projectiles. It works against normal shots and mortars. Those inside can still shoot out. It must be charged before use.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySignalJammer.label: enemy signal jammer
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySignalJammer.description: An advanced jamming array that disrupts local guidance signals, preventing the deployment of gravships and drop pods in its immediate vicinity. This particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_AncientGravmine.label: ancient gravmine
LanguageData.VGE_AncientGravmine.description: An ancient and incredibly unstable high-explosive device designed for space-based combat. It features a large detection radius that triggers a powerful blast detonation upon the approach.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySmallThruster.label: enemy small thruster
LanguageData.VGE_EnemySmallThruster.description: An astrofuel thruster that increases the range and maximum size of the gravship.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyLargeThruster.label: enemy large thruster
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyLargeThruster.description: An advanced astrofuel thruster with a heat-resistant vacstone liner. It greatly increases the range and maximum size of the gravship.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGiantThruster.label: enemy giant thruster
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGiantThruster.description: A massive, reinforced astrofuel thruster built with advanced alloys and ultra-dense vacstone plating. It massively increases the range and maximum size of the gravship\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravFieldExtender.label: enemy grav field extender
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravFieldExtender.description: An ultratech device used to increase the size of a gravship. It extends the area in which substructure can be built, and increases the amount of substructure that a gravship can support.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravFieldAmplifier.label: enemy grav field amplifier
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravFieldAmplifier.description: An advanced ultratech device that dramatically increases the size of a gravship. It extends the area in which substructure can be built, and increases the amount of substructure that a gravship can support.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_AncientSignalJammer.label: ancient signal jammer
LanguageData.VGE_AncientSignalJammer.description: An archaic broadcasting array emitting a high-frequency interference field that cripples long-range communications and disrupts gravship navigational locks. As long as it’s active, gravship or shuttle launches from this area will not be possible, and comms consoles will not be able to be used. It contains a valuable gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_AncientSignalJammer.comps.1.label: Signal jammer
LanguageData.VGE_AncientSignalJammer.comps.1.text: You've discovered an ancient signal jammer actively preventing vessels from leaving the area. Destroy it to lift the lockdown and obtain a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussCannon.label: enemy gauss cannon
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussCannon.description: A massive, single-barrel anti-ship cannon that uses powerful electromagnets to launch large metallic darts at extreme velocities. While formidable, ships equipped with ultratech signal jammers can temporarily paralyze its targeting systems, rendering it unable to fire during the disruption.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be destroyed to yield some valuable resources, including a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussCannon.comps.3.label: Gauss cannon
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussCannon.comps.3.text: You've discovered a gauss cannon, a devastating piece of orbital artillery. Destroy it to eliminate the threat and obtain a gravcore.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGaussCannon.label: enemy gauss cannon
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGaussCannon.description: An incredibly powerful anti-ship gauss artillery mounted on an orbital station.
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_GaussCannon.label: gauss cannon shot
LanguageData.VGE_Turret_DefenderTurret.label: defender turret
LanguageData.VGE_Turret_DefenderTurret.description: An armored security turret containing containing a built-in power source.
LanguageData.VGE_Bullet_DefenderTurret.label: defender turret bullet
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_DefenderTurret.label: defender turret gun
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_DefenderTurret.description: A simple automatic gun made to be mounted on a turret.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipMinigunTurret.label: enemy gravship minigun turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipMinigunTurret.descripti: A compact gravship-mounted heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGravshipMinigun.label: gravship minigun
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipAutocannonTurret.label: enemy gravship autocannon turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipAutocannonTurret.descri: A compact gravship-mounted automatic turret. Its large-caliber shells do heavy damage over significant ranges, but despite its efficiency, the barrel must be refurbished after heavy use. It cannot fire at close-up targets, and may explode when damaged.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGravshipAutocannon.label: gravship autocannon
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipUraniumSlugTurret.label: enemy gravship uranium slug turret
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipUraniumSlugTurret.descr: A compact gravship-mounted armor-piercing turret. Its ultra-dense uranium shells can punch through heavy armor, but it requires new uranium slugs to be loaded after use. More efficient than its ground version, it consumes fewer slugs per shot. It's more accurate at longer ranges, and can't fire at all close up. May explode when damaged.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGravshipUraniumSlug.label: gravship uranium slug gun
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyOxygenPump.label: enemy oxygen pump
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyOxygenPump.description: A unit connected to the gravship’s life support network. It keeps rooms heated and pressurized.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravshipLight_red.label: enemy gravship light
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussHowitzer.label: enemy gauss howitzer
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGaussHowitzer.description: A triple-barrel electromagnetic artillery piece that fires dense uranium slugs at high velocity. Designed for both local bombardments and long-range engagements, it can also target other gravships in orbit. It draws power directly from the grav engine and does not require a linked terminal to function.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyGaussHowitzer.label: enemy gauss howitzer
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyJavelinLauncher.label: enemy javelin launcher
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyJavelinLauncher.description: A heavy multi-tube missile platform that fires a spread of 12 long-range guided astrofuel-propelled javelins. Designed for saturation strikes against surface targets and rival gravships in orbit. It draws power directly from the grav engine and does not require a linked terminal to function.\n\nThis particular device is owned by the enemy and can't be decrypted or unlocked. It can still be deconstructed to yield some valuable resources.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_EnemyJavelinLauncher.label: enemy javelin launcher
